name: Anthropic Messages API (client tools)

example.name: get_weather
example.description: Get the current weather in a given location

fields.name: required; must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$
fields.description: detailed plain-text description (docs: 'most important factor'; aim for 3-4+ sentences)
fields.input_schema: required; JSON Schema object for the parameters
fields.input_examples: optional; array of example inputs, each must validate against input_schema (invalid -> 400); not supported on server tools or computer/browser toolsets
fields.strict: optional; true = grammar-constrained sampling, input guaranteed to match input_schema and name always valid
fields.cache_control / defer_loading / allowed_: optional properties listed in Tool reference (not detailed here)

tool_result.error: Same tool_result block with "is_error": true and the error message in content. content is optional and may be a string or an array of text/image/document/search_result blocks. tool_result blocks must immediately follow the assistant tool_use turn and must come FIRST in the user message content (text only after them, else 400).

schema_rules: Non-strict: any JSON Schema object for input_schema (no subset documented on define-tools page).

Strict (strict: true) / structured outputs subset: supported = basic types object/array/string/integer/number/boolean/null, enum (primitive values only), const, anyOf, allOf (not with $ref), $ref/$def/definitions (no external $ref), default, required, additionalProperties (must be false for objects), string formats date-time/time/date/duration/email/hostname/uri/ipv4/ipv6/uuid, array minItems only 0 or 1.

Strict NOT supported: recursive schemas, complex types in enums, external $ref, numeric constraints (minimum/maximum/multipleOf), string minLength/maxLength, array constraints beyond minItems 0/1, additionalProperties other than false. Unsupported feature -> 400.

Strict complexity limits per request (combined across all strict schemas): max 20 strict tools; max 24 optional parameters (any property not in required); max 16 parameters using union types (anyOf or type arrays like ["string","null"]).
Strict mode does NOT require all properties to be in required (docs examples have optional properties); optional ones count toward the 24 limit.
